f2_9_blunt_handle_diagnosis.verdict: FAIL (kept). zero_new_labels, one_component and mass checks hold; grip contact-window mean |F| = 0.0767 N against the declared > 0.1 N.
f2_9_blunt_handle_diagnosis.numbers: 45 press/hold steps (handle_press 1.38-1.96 s, 30 steps at 10 mm/s; handle_hold 1.98-2.26 s, 15 steps). Grip contact on 30 steps (1.68-2.26 s): the grip -y face starts 3 mm outside the bar side (y = 17.8 mm vs face 15 mm) and first touches at y = 14.8 mm. Force rises 0.028 -> 0.131 N over the 15 contact steps of the press (max 0.1308 N at the 6 mm stop), then decays during the hold 0.105 -> 0.018 N. Blade contacts 0, stroke never active, min det F 0.975.
f2_9_blunt_handle_diagnosis.geometry: The grip box spans edge-frame 60-120 mm along the edge line from the edge centre (handle beyond the 60 mm edge half-length), i.e. world x = 60-120 mm, while the CUT-03-K2 bar ends at x = 80 mm. Its z range is local 10-34 mm against a 20 mm bar. The contact patch is therefore only about 20 mm x 10 mm (2e-4 m^2) at the free +x end corner of the bar; peak mean pressure 0.65 kPa.
f2_9_blunt_handle_diagnosis.mechanism_with_data: The 3 mm nominal indentation went into rigid motion of the bar, not into compression. CUT-03-K2 has no fixture walls: the bar rests on two pedestals (x = -90..-20 and 20..90 mm) with friction 0.3 only. History frames (0.1 s) show the bar end at x > 60 mm moving -3.09 mm (grip side), -3.03 mm (core) and -3.00 mm (far -y face) at t = 2.0 s: across-width compression is at most 0.13 mm (0.45% strain). A linear fit of the core band gives a yaw of 1.29 deg (t = 2.0 s) to 1.50 deg (t = 2.3 s) about x = -43 mm, centroid -1.13 mm; it stays (1.41 deg at t = 8 s) because friction holds the bar where it was pushed. So the force is set by the bar's frictional resistance to yaw and its bending, not by its 50 kPa stiffness. Order of magnitude: mu W = 0.3 x 1.413 N = 0.42 N bounds sliding; the textbook minimum for yawing a uniform rod pushed at one end is (sqrt 2 - 1) mu W = 0.18 N about a pivot L/sqrt 2 = 113 mm from the pushed end (x = -33 mm), close to the measured 0.131 N peak and x = -43 mm pivot. When the grip stops, the bar comes to rest against it and the residual contact force decays (0.018 N at the end of the hold). For comparison, a constrained 3 mm compression across 30 mm on 2e-4 m^2 would give about E eps A = 1.0 N elastically, capped by the 1 kPa yield near 0.2-0.6 N; both exceed 0.1 N.
f2_9_blunt_handle_diagnosis.conclusion: The negative control was not loaded enough to be informative about blunt-contact labelling under load: it shows zero labels at about 0.08 N mean, not at > 0.1 N. This is a control-design flaw (unrestrained workpiece, grip mostly beyond the bar end), not a law-8 labelling event; the FAIL record is unchanged.
f2_9_blunt_handle_diagnosis.proposed_v2_row_not_run: Declare a new protocol version before running; keep v1's FAIL. (1) Place the grip over material and support: shift the plan by -40 mm along x so the 60 mm grip spans x = 20-80 mm over the right pedestal, and lower it so the grip covers bar z = 2-20 mm (blade still >= 8 mm outside the side face, above the pedestal top). (2) React the press: add a -y backstop fixture box beside the bar on that pedestal (a CUT-03-K2 variant with a declared fixture), or press the grip -z onto the bar top over the pedestal, which the flat-press row shows gives > 1 N. (3) Keep the > 0.1 N contact-window criterion and add a report-only workpiece rigid-body displacement and across-width compression metric, so that an unrestrained workpiece cannot absorb the press unnoticed.

law8_validated_for: Kinematic ideal tracking, 1 mm / 4 mm / 0.1 ms (and 0.05 ms), seed 42, ruler_knife_v2_y double bevel, CUT-03-K2 / CUT-04-K2-W60 / TRIM-02-K2 geometries.

Plow-gate boundary: rho = 14 and 15 deg never plow (0/168 cutting steps); 16 deg plows on 168/168 steps and 100% of segments; all three separate (removal 0.941 / 0.933 / 0.933, substrate >= 0.99987). The switch at 15 deg has no effect on the separation outcome at these rakes.

In-plane vertical cut, +/-10 deg rocking, sawing with descent, pure rotation, pure draw, withdrawal, finite edge (half the bar under the edge), negative controls flat press (1.49 N), side push (0.32 N), no contact; re-contact without re-merge; three sequential cuts plus a push on tlmpm_v5 with no digit rewrite or slot overflow.
law8_not_validated_for: Chisel profile: the C4 finding (ADR 0013 C4 record) stands. The plow gate measures motion against the blade plane, not the pushing face; a chisel's top face pushes the chip at rho + 25 deg while the gate sees 5-10 deg, so ejected chip particles stay code 0 and bridge (rho = 10 deg FAIL). Phase F did not test the chisel.
Blunt-handle contact under a load > 0.1 N (F2.9_blunt_handle FAIL, see diagnosis).
Calibrated material: all parameters are provisional; reaction forces are not dt- or spacing-converged (F3).
Isaac Lab or live robot tracking: every row is kinematic ideal tracking; no Lab run exists.

Swept normal during sawing under tracking noise: it is ill-conditioned. In F2.6_saw_cut the host-side |m x e|^2 falls to 8.4e-8 (m/s)^2 (|m x e| = 0.29 mm/s against segment speeds up to 93 mm/s, 0.3%); in F2.6_pure_draw m x e = 0 on all 40 draw steps and the normal falls back to the blade normal. Ideal tracking gives a 0.0 deg normal error, but an out-of-plane velocity error comparable to 0.3 mm/s would rotate the swept normal by about 45 deg.

Stroke persistence for rotation: the 2 dx persistence budget counts edge-centre travel only (tlmpm_v4 _update_stroke uses the linear twist). In F2.5 the centre segment had zero speed on all 25 rotate steps (max_travel_since_engaged = 0); the stroke stayed active because the outer segments did cutting work. A non-working rotation about the edge centre would never exhaust the budget; untested.

Resolutions other than 1 mm / 4 mm: TRIM separation fails at 2 mm and at 1.5 mm (supplementary); the frozen 2 mm cut-location statistic is below the ideal-partition floor there. The declared medium row did not run.
f2_11_report_only: F2.11 PASS on its protocol criterion (4 parts, digits 0/1/2 unchanged after later cuts and the push, 0 slot overflow). The report-only configured-goal evaluation fails cut_at_declared_planes for planes 1 and 2 (midpoint statistic 4.0 / 4.5 mm vs the 2 mm bound; the ideal labels give 1.5 mm): earlier cuts move the bar before later cuts, as in M8b. Not a Phase F criterion; reported, not rescored.
